title: Training Grounds #41–#60 become Legacy cards, named, tagged and decked apart from their Core cards
notes: Training Grounds #41–#60 are renamed Legacy: <Core name> and tagged Legacy (R2511000); each is its own card, so a deck may hold it beside its Core card and a Discover may offer both (R2511001). Cost, stats, text, rarity, set and picture are unchanged.

player.title: Training Grounds' Core copies become Legacy cards
new: A new tag, Legacy, on the twenty Training Grounds copies of Core cards. The deck builder and the Almanac can filter on it.
changes: The twenty Training Grounds copies of Core cards are now the Legacy cards, each its own card: a deck may hold a Legacy card beside the Core card it copies.
A Discover may offer a Core card and its Legacy card together.
text: Each Legacy card is named Legacy: and its Core card's name, for example Legacy: Bigot. Its cost, stats, text, rarity and picture are unchanged.
